text:
Predicates:
GenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
UnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputText(x) ::: x is a text sequence.
ProcessingTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
Translation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (GenerationTask(x) ∨ UnderstandingTask(x)) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (OutputText(x) → GenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
Translation(machine) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
OutputText(machine) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
GenerationTask(translation) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
